title: hieracium jurassicum subsp. subperfoliatum
intro: Hieracium jurassicum subsp. subperfoliatum, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species within the dandelion family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium jurassicum subsp. subperfoliatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-cancer activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of Hieracium jurassicum subsp. subperfoliatum in traditional medicine and as a potential therapeutic agent.
